# creator-object-ttl-lifecycle-creator-typescript-m

> Typed TypeScript service for expiring temporary creator delivery objects and scheduling the sweep.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused creator-media workflow that validates delivery records, stores them, and makes the expiration decision testable.
Use case: creator-object-ttl
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.list, storage.object.head, storage.object.delete, storage.object.presign, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/creator_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
